name: mdx-ui-stack
rules: Svelte is the aligned frontend choice for MDx v2 operational UI
UI is read-only until write paths have policy, session, and receipt contracts
Concierge answers are grounded in generated read models and source receipt ids
Twin shell remains read-only and receipt-grounded until governed action rails are green
local console home is operational, read-only, and not a marketing page
Observatory, Concierge, Twin, Pages, Message, Start, and MDx expose shared local console navigation
UI explains operational state before exposing raw proof drilldowns
agent-readable design source of truth stays in DESIGN.md and docs/DESIGN.md
structured agent state comes before prose
source boundary is required for every shippable UI element
system, dark, and light theme modes are required before product-ready status
blank screens and raw errors are release blockers
Message is an agent-first communication app over event and thread projections
Start is the local-first install confidence surface over the fresh install readiness route
MDx is the unified product shell that composes app modules after local install readiness is proven
Pages is the knowledge app over World Model evidence
